verdict.rationale: ImageMagick ships language bindings and a CLI, so a machine-readable API description is a fair question to ask. But the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path, and nothing in the evidence shows an equivalent machine-readable spec for its APIs. The llms.txt file is a prose overview for LLMs, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
